# ubiops_project_user (Resource)

Assigns a user to a UbiOps project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_project_user" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  user_id      = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the user

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email of the user
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (UUID)
- `name` (String) Name of the user
- `surname` (String) Surname of the user

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_project_user.example my-project/aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee
```
